disciplinary_grounds.description: Lack of trustworthiness and competence to transact real estate brokerage services in a manner that safeguards the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Lack of trustworthiness and competence to transact real estate brokerage services in such manner as to safeguard the interests of the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act or conduct demonstrating bad faith, incompetency, untrustworthiness, dishonesty, fraud, or improper dealings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any act or conduct, whether of the same or different character than specified in this chapter, that constitutes or demonstrates bad faith, incompetency, untrustworthiness or dishonest, fraudulent or improper dealings

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or attempting to perform any act for which a license may lawfully be denied
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or attempting to perform any act or acts for which a license may lawfully be denied to any applicant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any substantial misrepresentation by omission or commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any substantial misrepresentation by omission or commission, but not including innocent misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to act prudently to protect and promote the interests of the principal with absolute fidelity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to act in a reasonably prudent manner in order to protect and promote the interests of the principal with absolute fidelity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to act prudently to avoid error, exaggeration, or concealment of pertinent information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to act in a reasonably prudent manner in order to avoid error, exaggeration or concealment of pertinent information

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the chapter by a licensed or unlicensed person on the agency's behalf where the designated broker had prior knowledge, permitted unauthorized activity, or failed to reasonably supervise
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of this chapter by a licensed or unlicensed person acting on the agency's behalf if: A. The designated broker had prior knowledge and did not take reasonable action to prevent the violation; B. The designated broker permitted or authorized a person to engage in activity for which that person was not properly licensed; or C. The designated broker failed to exercise a reasonable degree of supervision over employees and independent contractors commensurate with their qualifications and experience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, promising, or paying compensation to an unlicensed person for services requiring a license, or accepting compensation from anyone other than the employing agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, promising, allowing, giving or paying, directly or indirectly, any part or share of compensation arising or accruing from a real estate brokerage transaction to any person who is not licensed to perform the service for which the person is or would be compensated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having had a professional or occupational license application rejected for untrustworthiness within 3 years, or a license suspended or revoked for disciplinary reasons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having had a professional or occupational license application rejected for reasons related to untrustworthiness within 3 years prior to the date of application or had a professional or occupational license suspended or revoked for disciplinary reasons

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet professional qualifications for licensure or failing to submit a complete application within 30 days of notification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to meet the professional qualifications for licensure as provided in this subchapter or failing to submit a complete application within 30 days after being notified of the materials needed to complete the application.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Every agency holding an active license shall maintain a fixed and definite place of business where its designated broker and employees may be personally contacted without unreasonable delay.

definition_quote.value: Real estate brokerage means a single instance of offering, attempting to conduct or conducting services on behalf of another for compensation, or with the expectation of receiving compensation, calculated to result in the transfer of an interest in real estate.
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate brokerage" means a single instance of offering, attempting to conduct or conducting services on behalf of another for compensation, or with the expectation of receiving compensation, calculated to result in the transfer of an interest in real estate.

value: Listing real estate for sale or exchange

methods_authorized.quote: Real estate brokerage includes, but is not limited to, the following activities conducted in behalf of another: A. Listing real estate for sale or exchange; B. Promoting the purchase, sale or exchange of real estate; C. Procuring of prospects calculated to result in the purchase, sale or exchange of real estate; D. Advertising or holding oneself out as offering any services described in this subsection; E. Negotiating the purchase, sale or exchange of real estate; F. Buying options on real estate or selling real estate options or the real estate under option; G. Acting as a finder to facilitate the purchase, sale or exchange of real estate; and H. Buying, selling or exchanging real estate.

license_tiers.quote: "Real estate broker" or "broker" means any person employed by or on behalf of an agency to perform brokerage and licensed by the commission as a broker.

broker_of_record_required.quote: The owner or a duly authorized agency official shall hold a Maine real estate broker license and be designated by the agency to act for it in the conduct of real estate brokerage.

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: The applicant must have been licensed as an associate broker affiliated with a real estate brokerage agency for 2 years within the 5 years immediately preceding the date of application.

inactive_license_max_years.quote: Licensees who have remained on inactive status for 6 years or more may have their licenses reinstated to active status by submitting an application and fee and by successfully passing a license examination designated by commission rule for this purpose.

agency_relationship_types.quote: Such a real estate brokerage agency may be a seller agent, a buyer agent, a subagent or a disclosed dual agent.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A real estate brokerage agency may act as a disclosed dual agent only with the informed written consent of all parties.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: A real estate brokerage agency entering into a brokerage agreement may, through the designated broker, appoint in writing to the client those affiliated licensees within the real estate brokerage agency who will be acting as appointed agents of that client to the exclusion of all other affiliated licensees within the real estate brokerage agency.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: "Transaction broker" means a real estate brokerage agency that provides real estate brokerage services to one or more parties in a real estate transaction without a fiduciary relationship as a buyer agent, a seller agent, a subagent or a disclosed dual agent.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: A real estate brokerage agency shall provide in a timely manner to buyers and sellers of residential real property a meaningful, written real estate brokerage relationship disclosure form as defined and mandated by rules adopted by the commission.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: A brokerage agreement between a real estate brokerage agency and a client must be in writing and, at a minimum, include the following: A. The signature of the client to be charged; B. The terms and conditions of the brokerage services to be provided; C. The method or amount of compensation to be paid; D. The date upon which the agreement will expire; and E. A statement that the agreement creates an agency-client relationship.

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: The date upon which the agreement will expire

escrow_account_required.quote: Every agency shall maintain a federally insured account or accounts in a financial institution authorized to do business in this State... for the sole purpose of depositing all earnest money deposits and all other money held by it as an agency in which its clients or other persons with whom it is dealing have an interest.

fixed_office_required.quote: Every agency holding an active license shall maintain a fixed and definite place of business where its designated broker and employees may be personally contacted without unreasonable delay.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: Every person employed by or on behalf of the agency in the performance of real estate brokerage shall be properly licensed under this chapter.

value: Transactions by property owner or lessor (and their regular employees regarding employer's real estate)
Transactions by attorneys-at-law performing duties as attorney (except those regularly engaged in real estate brokerage)
Licensed auctioneers hired to call bids at auction (if they do not prepare contracts, control the sale, or take custody of purchase price)
Real estate transaction services subject to Title 33, chapter 10-A (time share)
license_exemptions.quote: Real estate brokerage does not include the following: 1. Transactions conducted by any person who is the owner or lessor of the real estate, or to their regular employees with regard to the employer's real estate... 2. Transactions conducted by an attorney-at-law in the performance of duties as an attorney-at-law... 3. A person licensed as an auctioneer under chapter 5‑B, hired to call bids at an auction, if the person employed does not prepare contracts or otherwise control the actual sale or take custody of any part of the purchase price; and 4. Real estate transaction services subject to the provisions of Title 33, chapter 10‑A.
